title: OpenAI releases 372 groups of math results from unreleased frontier AI model
hook_text: OpenAI just released unreleased math results.
script:
OpenAI published math results from an unreleased frontier artificial intelligence model.
The company shared three hundred seventy two groups of math results.
The data appeared inside a public repository instead of being hidden.
These benchmarks highlight how the new frontier model evaluates mathematical reasoning.
What do you think these new math benchmarks reveal about the upcoming model?
